title: site.remove_locale, contract version 1
description: Retires a locale of a registered site (PRD 5.9, 11.14) in one changeset: the site stops publishing in the locale, and the routes in the locale stay retired with it until site.add_locale brings them back. The issuing actor needs site.remove_locale on the site's root node in the locale, and a root its grants do not reach is unauthorized. While a placement locale in the locale anywhere on the site is not withdrawn, the command is site_locale_in_use with the count, and a placement created in the locale between the read and the commit is version_conflict. A site that does not exist, a locale the site does not publish in, and the site's last locale are validation_failed; a site at another version than the caller read is version_conflict. cms:sites:sync runs it as the installation operator for each locale the configuration no longer names. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Structure\Domain\Commands\RemoveSiteLocale, and the generated codec RemoveSiteLocaleCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

site.description: The id of the site to address.

version.description: The version of the site the caller read.

locale.description: The locale the site stops publishing in.

A language tag of a language, an optional script and an optional region, such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS; the kernel writes the language in lowercase, the script in title case and the region in uppercase.

version.description: The version of an aggregate that the caller read, an integer of 1 or more; the command is version_conflict when the aggregate is at another version when it commits.
